description: Suspends a test member in Development, at once with no approval — the dashboard's own suspend: they are signed out everywhere and can't sign in; their account, records and payments stay. For proving what the app shows a suspended person. Test members only (made with test_member_add); anyone else is refused, and it never reaches Live — Live's customers through request_live_action suspend_person, approved by the founder. test_member_unsuspend lifts it. On the founder's Logs.
name: test_member_suspend
title: Suspend a test member
